_description: Days on which Tesouro Direto D+1 purchase settlement did not occur although they are not national holidays (B3/Sao Paulo closures, 24/31 December, 2014 World Cup). Inferred from the official Tesouro Transparente price history: on the previous business day, purchase prices reconcile with the official methodology only if settlement rolls past these dates (and fail otherwise). du is still counted on the national calendar.
_method: scripts/derive_settlement_closures.py over LTN and NTN-F purchase prices, 2004-12-31 to 2026-10-30; a date is accepted when <50% of securities reconcile at D+1 and >90% at D+2.
_future_rule: From 2026 onwards, 24 and 31 December are assumed non-settlement days (observed pattern).
